ṯꜣi — to seize, take, carry off (verb; Budge: t'ai, 'who seizeth') — w35
nsb — to lick, swallow, devour (verb; written with the tongue ns; Budge: nesbu, 'eateth') — w37
ḥwꜣw — rottenness, putrid matter, rotting flesh (noun; from ḥwꜣ 'to rot, stink'; written with the pustule; Budge: ḥuau, 'entrails') — w41
smꜣ-wr — Sema-wer, 'the Great Wild Bull' (?), a god named as the ba of Geb (god's name; smꜣ 'wild bull' + wr 'great'; reading of the first sign pair uncertain; Budge: Smam-ur) — w57+w58
pꜣwt — the primeval gods, the first company of gods (?) (noun f.; from pꜣ 'be first, of old'; written with the flying pintail pꜣ and round loaves; reading doubtful; Budge: paut) — w66
sip — to inspect, check, examine (verb; participle sipw 'who inspect'; sipw 'inventory' is the noun from it; Budge: sàpu) — w76
bwt — abomination, what is taboo, what one detests (noun f.; written with the bird of bad things) — w113
msqt — the Meseqet, a place in the world below (place name; meaning of the name not clear; Budge: Mesqet) — w119
BROADEN bgꜣ — perhaps also weariness, inertness, the state of the dead (noun; written with the weary man and the bird of bad things; imyw bgꜣ 'those who are in weariness') (?) — w48
BROADEN skr — also skry, the bark of Sokar on its sledge (?) (noun; written with the boat on a sledge) — w45
BROADEN ḏt — a second word of the same spelling: body, person (noun f.; ḏt·f 'his body') — w67
BROADEN iꜣt — a second word of the same spelling: a place of slaughter (?) (noun f.; written with the leg crossed by a knife and the house; Budge: àati, 'slaughter-houses'; reading and sense uncertain) — w90, w102
BROADEN smꜣ — also smꜣwt, place of killing (?) (noun f.; with the house sign; Budge: samatu) — w107
BROADEN ꜣḫ — also ꜣḫ n, to be of use to, serve, benefit (someone) (verb) — w82
BROADEN sꜣw — a second word of the same spelling: to guard, keep watch over, restrain (verb); sꜣwt guard, custody, watch (noun f.; written with the seated man holding a stick, A47; Budge: satu, saut) — w85, w94
